scripts.check-wasm-file-exists: test -f ./public/static/js/main.wasm || (echo 'public/static/js/main.wasm file does not exist!'; exit 1)
scripts.check-mpc-worker-file-exists: test -f ./public/static/js/mpcWorker-bundle.js || (echo 'public/static/js/mpcWorker-bundle.js file does not exist!'; exit 1)
scripts.deploy-s3: yarn && yarn build && yarn check-wasm-file-exists && yarn check-mpc-worker-file-exists && aws s3 sync build/ s3://capsule-$REACT_APP_ENV-web-portal --acl public-read --profile $REACT_APP_ENV
scripts.setup-worker: cd ../../../go-sdk && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -o ../web-sdk/sites/portal/public/static/js/main.wasm wasm/main.go && cd ../web-sdk/packages/web-sdk && yarn && yarn build && cd ../../sites/portal
